decisions.reason: The two-component resin injection unit builds directly on the firm's core expertise in dosing and injection equipment, so it can interpret early results and keep improving the product, and the website showed it consistently.
Like Product A, this resin injection unit sits squarely within the firm's existing knowledge base, which supports continued assimilation and refinement rather than withdrawal.
Automatic airless spray guns are a natural extension of the firm's core airless coating technology, giving it strong capacity to learn from market feedback and improve the product.
The manual airless spray gun is a staple product closely tied to established know-how and customer base, so the firm can evaluate and develop it with little difficulty.
Air-assisted airless technology combines knowledge the firm already holds in airless and air spraying, so it can absorb lessons from use and refine the gun effectively.

The data logger draws on electronics and software knowledge further from the firm's mechanical core, and its downgrade from a page of its own to a mere mention signals weaker commitment, but its digital complementarity to the coating equipment still argues for keeping it for now.
